title.en: Marvell and Lumentum sign an all-stock acquisition agreement
title.zhHans: Marvell 与 Lumentum 签署全股票收购协议

searchSummary.en: Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal with a stated $115 billion implied enterprise value; closing remains conditional.
searchSummary.zhHans: Marvell 同意以全股票交易收购 Lumentum，公告所列隐含企业价值为 1150 亿美元；交易仍待交割。

summary.en: Marvell and Lumentum announced a definitive all-stock acquisition agreement on November 2. The companies stated an implied enterprise value of $115 billion for Lumentum. They expect to close in the first half of 2028, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. No completed transfer or realized integration is established.
summary.zhHans: Marvell 与 Lumentum 于 11 月 2 日宣布签署全股票收购的最终协议。两家公司称，Lumentum 的隐含企业价值为 1150 亿美元。交易预计于 2028 年上半年完成，仍须取得股东和监管批准。现有证据不证明所有权已经转移或业务已整合。

narrative.en: The agreement is the dated action, not a closed merger. The $115 billion figure is the announced enterprise value, not cash consideration paid or an independent valuation. The SEC-hosted copy shares the companies’ origin and is not independent corroboration of their projections.
narrative.zhHans: 本节点记录签约，而非并购完成。1150 亿美元是公告中的隐含企业价值，不是已经支付的现金或独立估值。提交给美国证监会的文件仍源于交易双方，不能当作对其预测的独立验证。

text.en: The companies announced a definitive all-stock agreement on November 2, valuing Lumentum at an implied $115 billion enterprise value.
text.zhHans: 两家公司于 11 月 2 日宣布最终全股票交易协议，所列 Lumentum 隐含企业价值为 1150 亿美元。

text.en: The planned first-half-2028 closing remains subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
text.zhHans: 计划于 2028 年上半年交割，仍须取得股东和监管批准。
